text:
This addon provides:

* Two People tiddlers, one to list people by birthplace and the other to list people by burial place.
** These are available under the People menu item in the Contents tab of the side bar.
* Events (by month)
** This is available under the Events menu item in the Contents of the side bar.
* Referenced Images
** This is a media menu item to list all images referenced throughout the solution.
